integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames the professional woman shown in <Picture 1> at her office desk. With a flick of both wrists, she dismisses the thermometer hologram and expands the K-line diagram, splitting it into two enlarged candlesticks floating side by side — one red with its close near the top, one green with its close near the bottom. She pushes her right palm forward toward the red candlestick; its upper portion glows intensely, and a small upward arrow icon appears above it. She then turns her palm toward the green candlestick; its lower portion darkens and a downward arrow icon appears. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed from medium-wide to a medium-close shot, tightening on her face and the two candlesticks. She straightens her posture slightly, her expression shifting to a more focused, professional look with a hint of allure, one eyebrow subtly raised, as the woman (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 所以，收盘价接近最高价，说明多方力量很强；反过来，接近最低价，就说明空方占优了。记住了吗？</d> She taps her temple lightly with her index finger on "记住了吗？", then points at the camera with the same finger, her lips pressed into a playful, knowing smile.

overall_soundscape: The office ambient hum persists beneath the soft electronic pulse of the holographic display. Her palm pressing against the holographic interface produces a deep, resonant bass tone, and the arrow icons appearing generate crisp digital blips. The squeak of her office chair as she straightens her posture and the subtle tap of her finger against her temple add tactile realism.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-close shot frames the professional woman shown in <Picture 1> at her securities firm desk. She sweeps both hands together in front of her, and the two candlestick holograms merge back into a single, complete annotated K-line diagram with all labels visible — "开盘价," "收盘价," "最高价," "最低价," "上影线," "下影线," and "实体" — each element glowing softly in its designated position. She traces both hands along the full outline of the K-line with a fluid, conductor-like motion, and the entire diagram pulses once with a warm golden light. She leans back slightly in her chair, crossing one leg over the other beneath the desk, and lifts her chin with a confident, radiant smile. The camera pedestals up with small amplitude at slow speed and simultaneously pulls out to a medium-wide framing, capturing her full upper body and the glowing holographic summary diagram beside her. She gives a small, graceful wave toward the camera with her right hand, her eyes warm and inviting, as the woman (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 看懂K线，就是看懂多空双方的博弈。阳线越长，买方越积极；阴线越长，卖方越急切。你学会了吗？</d> On "你学会了吗？", she tilts her head, blinks slowly, and lets her smile linger as the holographic diagram slowly dims behind her.

overall_soundscape: The office ambient hum and computer fan drone provide a steady base. Her hands sweeping through the holographic field produce a broad, resonant shimmer sound, and the golden pulse of the diagram emits a warm, bell-like chime. Her office chair creaks softly as she leans back and crosses her legs, and the faint rustle of her skirt fabric is audible. Distant keyboard typing and a muffled conversation from the hallway round out the realistic office soundscape.
